checks.note: tool_proposed, tool_error and tool_result rows are written with run_id and timestamp; the error branch is logged too.
Allow, deny and pending decisions are recorded with policy_version; unknown-tool denials too.

Execution rows carry approval_id, but the approval_requested and approval_decided event kinds are never written anywhere. ApprovalStore.request and decide only INSERT and UPDATE the mutable approvals table. The approver, outcome and decision time are not in the linked execution graph, so a run that waited on an approval can't be rebuilt from the record.

The ID is created before the call and errors are logged with it. The code has no retries. The ID is not sent to the destination, but the payments Idempotency-Key and the ERP client_reference cover matching.
The harness writes rows before and after each action, and the model has no audit tool.

note: Approval requests and decisions are never written as audit events, so approvals live only in a mutable side table and not in the execution graph.
